evals.name: web-with-brand-overrides
evals.prompt: Acme Ledger, invoicing and time tracking for freelancers. website with Next.js React. primary #0F766E secondary #F59E0B, Space Grotesk for headings. implement the nav and hero with real copy.
evals.expected_output: Matches the MoolaX capture, reproduces its nav/hero structure, accent is #0F766E and accent2 #F59E0B, Space Grotesk wired, copy about Acme Ledger with no MoolaX leakage.
assertions: Output is the requested platform
Project is structurally complete for its platform
Hero copy names the company
No template product name leaks into user-visible source
Reference screenshots are present in the project
Layout inventory recorded from the reference (LAYOUT.md rows filled)
Colour lives in a token system, not scattered through components
Ships real copy with no placeholder text
Reports which tokens changed versus the template
Requested primary #0F766E is a colour token
Requested secondary #F59E0B is a colour token
Requested display font (Space Grotesk) is wired
